faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the CMD Kerala Training Coordinator post?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application for the Training Coordinator position at CMD Kerala is 09 September 2026. Ensure your application is submitted before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What are the educational qualifications required for the Training Coordinator role?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a B. Tech in Food Technology or a Full-Time MBA in Marketing from a recognized Institution or University to be eligible for this post.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Training Coordinator position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Training Coordinator post is 40 years. Age relaxation is applicable for SC/ST/OBC/PWD and other eligible categories as per Kerala Government norms.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Training Coordinator post?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Training Coordinator position will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 50,000 per month.

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply for the CMD Kerala Training Coordinator recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted online through the official CMD Kerala website or the direct application link provided. Ensure all details are accurate and documents are uploaded correctly.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Training Coordinator post?
faq.answer: The selection process includes Application Screening, Criteria-based Screening, Written Test, Group Discussion, Skill Test/Proficiency Test, and Interview.

faq.question: Q8. What is the job type for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The Training Coordinator position is a contract-based job.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I find the official notification PDF?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be downloaded from the Important Links section of this article. It contains detailed information about the recruitment.

faq.question: Q10. What is the advertisement number for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The advertisement number for this recruitment is CMD/AB/02/2026.
